questions.stem_text:
Discuss the concept of 'de facto' organs of the State in international law. Analyze how
these entities are recognized and their implications for state responsibility.
questions.gold_answer:
'De facto organs' are the persons, which are, in fact, acting on the instructions of, or
under the direction or control of, that State in carrying out the conduct attributable to
the State. Explain why this is the correct answer and provide supporting evidence.
